rules: Select only candidates matching the declared target, outcome group, estimand, and allowed data family.
Select no more than one eligible estimate from each independent study for an analysis.
Apply the extraction protocol's timepoint and effect-selection rules before synthesis.
Exclude source-only and quantitatively non-poolable candidates from quantitative synthesis.

method_selection_policy: After identifying eligible independent evidence, select and justify a synthesis approach from the study data. The participant package does not prescribe a computation method.
